title: Prompt Arrangement Reduction on Your Home-Site Lease Repayment Down Payment
content:
**Home-Site Lease — arranging repayment promptly**

The down-payment percentage of a Home-Site Lease repayment agreement is reduced, in percentage points, according to how soon after the due date of the most recent rent charge the down payment is made.

| Calendar days after the due date of the most recent rent charge on which the down payment is made | Reduction of the down-payment percentage |
|---|---|
| within 15 | 1.0 point |
| more than 15 but within 30 | 0.5 points |
| more than 30 | none |

The reduction is subtracted from the down-payment percentage before the percentage is applied.

### Questions on the reduction

*Where are the boundaries?* A down payment made on day 15 after the due date earns 1.0 point; on day 16, 0.5 points; on day 30, 0.5 points; on day 31, none.

*Which due date counts?* The due date of the most recent rent charge on the lease.

*Hypothetical.* Rent due on 1 June; down payment made on 12 June, 11 days after: 1.0 point. Made on 25 June, 24 days after: 0.5 points. Made on 3 July after the July rent charge has fallen due on 1 July: 2 days after the most recent due date, so 1.0 point.
